Internal soundness of a region map

Source: R/rgnmap.R
rgnmapintg.Rd

Checks that a region map (a crosswalk from units, such as correctional facilities or police detachments, to the statistical regions that contain them) lists each unit once, gives every unit a region, and names only regions the reference geography knows. Run it on any crosswalk before tables are built on it.

Usage

rgnmapintg(map, unit, reg, regs = NULL)

Arguments

map

The region map, a data frame, one row per unit.

unit, reg

The names of its unit and region columns.

regs

NULL, or every valid region code (the identifier column of the population table); with NULL the third check is not run.

Value

A data frame of class rgnmapintg, one row per check: check, observed, expected (always 0) and pass.

Details

These are the failures a comparison against published output cannot see, because they would be present on both sides: a unit matched into two regions, a unit matched into none, a region code that is a typo or belongs to a neighbouring jurisdiction. None needs the geometry.

The checks as computed: "units assigned more than one region" counts rows whose (non-blank) unit repeats an earlier row's, whether or not the region differs, so an exact duplicate row also fails; "units assigned no region" counts rows whose region is NA or blank; "region codes not in the reference geography" counts non-blank region codes not in regs, compared as text after trimming spaces (so "3506" and 3506 match, "03506" does not).

See also

rgnmapcmp(), rgnmapalt().

Examples

# a simulated crosswalk of facilities to census divisions
cw <- data.frame(inst = c("North Jail", "South Jail", "East Jail"),
                 cd = c("3557", "3520", "3506"))
rgnmapintg(cw, "inst", "cd", regs = c("3557", "3520", "3506"))
#> rgnmapintg: every check passed 
#>                                        check observed expected pass
#>          units assigned more than one region        0        0 TRUE
#>                     units assigned no region        0        0 TRUE
#>  region codes not in the reference geography        0        0 TRUE
cw$cd[3] <- "2406"
rgnmapintg(cw, "inst", "cd", regs = c("3557", "3520", "3506"))
#> rgnmapintg: 1 of 3 checks failed 
#>                                        check observed expected  pass
#>          units assigned more than one region        0        0  TRUE
#>                     units assigned no region        0        0  TRUE
#>  region codes not in the reference geography        1        0 FALSE
cw2 <- rbind(cw, data.frame(inst = c("North Jail", "West Jail"),
                            cd = c("3560", "")))
rgnmapintg(cw2, "inst", "cd")
#> rgnmapintg: 2 of 2 checks failed 
#>                                check observed expected  pass
#>  units assigned more than one region        1        0 FALSE
#>             units assigned no region        1        0 FALSE
try(rgnmapintg(cw, "institution", "cd"))
#> Error : rgnmapintg: `map` has no column `institution`.
